notes:
Summary: CatalystStrata is evaluating Redwood Dedicated for high-throughput embeddings and a latency-sensitive trading-assistant product. Primary ask: contract-backed throughput guarantees + traffic shaping primitives so their premium routes never see tail latency spikes.

Key technical requirements (from SE call 2026-02-24):
- Throughput target: sustained 800 qps for embeddings pipeline (batching allowed), peak bursts to 1.5k qps for 30s windows.
- Latency SLOs: 95th < 120ms for small-chat (context <= 512 tokens), 95th < 350ms for embedding queries when batching is disabled.
- Reserved GPU planning: want a two-zone reserved pool (nvidia H100-equivalent) with explicit headroom: capacity for 10 concurrent large-seq chat sessions + 40 dedicated embedding workers.
- Traffic shaping: per-tenant priority lanes required. Must be able to create three priority tiers per route (critical, standard, background) with token-level quotas and preemptive throttling for background tier.
- Noisy-neighbor controls: hard per-tenant GPU-share caps + soft degradation path that falls back to a lighter quantized model variant when noisy neighbor threshold exceeded.
- Tenant isolation: strict KV cache partitioning and optional metadata isolation for PII-sensitive routes.

- 2026-02-03: Security questionnaire submitted (see drive:/security/CatalystStrata_Security_FAQ.md).

4) Post-POC: legal SLA draft, procurement review, finalize contract.
